raw_text: AIS tracking: Two PLAN warships including a Type 054A frigate have entered Hambantota Port, Sri Lanka. Ship IDs match vessels from PLAN Southern Theater Navy. Five-day port call expected. Indian intelligence flagging this as part of expanding Chinese naval footprint in IOR. Second Chinese naval visit to Hambantota this year.
clean_text: Two PLAN warships including Type 054A frigate docked at Hambantota Port, Sri Lanka. Five-day port call. Second Chinese naval visit this year.
